data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'geō', meaning 'earth'. The name Geof is believed to have been given to those who worked the land. In Christianity, this name may symbolize the servant of God who toils in His vineyard. The name Geof carries the meaning “Earth worker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Geof usually hope their child will grow to embody earth worker and live with faith, good character and purpose.

As such, the name Geof can be seen as a reminder to live a life of service to God and fellow humans. Additionally, the name may also be seen as a reminder of the resurrection of Christ, who as a man of the earth, rose from the dead and redeemed humanity.
